correlation_id.description: Unique identifier for correlating request/response pairs

force_json.description: Whether to force JSON output format from LLM

step.description: Current step number in the conversation

summary_handoff.description: Summary data for handoff between turns

system_prompt.description: System prompt to prepend to the conversation

action.description: Action identifier for the committed response

content.description: Content of the committed LLM response

fsm_state.description: Current finite state machine state after commit

tool_input.description: JSON-encoded tool input if a tool call was detected

tool_name.description: Name of the tool to invoke if applicable

next_message.description: Next message to append to the conversation

tool_result.description: Inner result of the tool execution

error.description: Error message if tool execution failed

name.description: Name of the tool that was executed

step_id.description: Step identifier for this tool execution
